messages:
sam.sales: Quick POC ask from OrionInc. They run locked-down build agents and can only allowlist static IPv4s. Need: (1) 2-week Dedicated POC (1 GPU), (2) static egress IPs to allowlist, (3) scoped API key that expires after the POC, (4) a rough price.

mai.runtime: We can do this via Redwood-managed egress attached to the Dedicated instance. Typical flow: we reserve 2 IPv4 /32s, publish them, provision a time-limited API key. Alternative is customer NAT but they said they can't change infra.

lee.netops: I can allocate the pair once region confirmed. Questions: region (us-east-1?), do they perform TLS interception? If yes, need to confirm passthrough.

sam.sales: Region = us-east-1. They do TLS interception but agreed to allow raw TCP 443 to our IPs (no cert rewriting).

ada.security: Please have them fill the POC intake form and sign the short POC DPA before keys are issued. Also confirm log retention (default 7 days) and whether they want request bodies persisted.

mai.runtime: Draft allowlist packet below (replace with canonical IPs once Lee posts them):

```
Allowlist packet for OrionInc POC
- Service hostname: dedicated-us-east-1.redwood.ai (TLS)
- Outbound IPs to allowlist (example): 3.120.45.77, 3.120.45.78
- Ports: TCP 443 outbound
- Purpose: 14-day Dedicated POC (1 GPU)
- Contacts: sam.sales@redwood.ai, lee.netops@redwood.ai, ada.security@redwood.ai

Firewall example:
- permit tcp any host 3.120.45.77 eq 443

Sample curl (replace key):
  curl -X POST https://dedicated-us-east-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer POC_KEY_EXPIRES_2026-05-01T23:59:59Z" \n    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n    -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck"}'
```

lee.netops: I'll open ENG-4552 and allocate the /32 pair; will post canonical IPs here by EOD. If they need IPv6 later we'll open a follow-up.

finance-bot: Estimated cost: 1 GPU Dedicated for 14 days ~ $1,400 (range $1k-$2.2k depending on model/throughput). Egress add-on prorated ~ $60-$120. Final quote to follow.

sam.sales: Great — I'll send the packet and intake link to their infra lead and ask them to return the ACL and signed DPA. Lee/ada/mai please update ENG-4552 with IPs/quote and I'll close the loop. :thumbsup:
